## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] New redaction behavior uses only synthetic test values.
- [ ] Input files remain read-only and symbolic links remain unfollowed.
- [ ] Generated output contains no absolute source paths.
- [ ] User-facing or manifest changes are documented.
